The '''Green Jerry Talisman''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Accessory]] found in [[Jerry Box]]es. It grants the user {{Stat|int|-1}}. It can be upgraded to the {{LI|Blue Jerry Talisman}} and further upgraded to the {{LI|Purple Jerry Talisman}} from where it can finally be upgraded to the {{LI|Golden Jerry Artifact}}.  
== Obtaining ==
The Green Jerry Talisman is found inside the [[Jerry Box]] with a {{Green| 6.61%}} from the Green and Blue Jerry Box and a {{Green|6.47%}} from the Purple Jerry Box.

It is not obtainable from the Golden Jerry Box.

== Trivia ==
*While its debuff of {{Stat|int|-1}} might sound unattractive at first, it still grants [[Accessory Power]].
*If the player is manually farming {{MobSprite|Hidden Jerry;Hidden Jerries}}, having {{stat|tracking}} reduces the chance of obtaining '''Green Jerry Talismans''' due to {{Item|Golden Jerry Box}}es not having them in the loot pool.
